meaning:
1) to serve as a necklace, adorn with a neck ornament
1a) (Qal) to serve as a necklace
1b) (Hiphil) to make a necklace

renderings.bsb: You are to furnish him liberally

renderings.kjv: compasseth them about as a chain

elsewhere.note: You shall furnish him liberally out of your flock, out of your threshing floor, and out of your wine press. As Yahweh your God has blessed you, you shall give…
Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.
